_comment: GroupPermissions: each key is an Entra app role / group name; the value is
an array of Permission.* roles auto-assigned alongside the group role to
every user mapped to that group (empty array = group role only).
UserAssignments: each entry maps a user UPN to one of the groups above.
A UPN whose Group has no GroupPermissions entry receives only the group role.
